description: Retrieves a specific membership within a Trello organization, using their respective IDs, to ascertain the member's role, status, or permissions.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for retrieving a specific membership of an organization.

idMembership.description: The ID of the membership to retrieve.
idMembership.title: Id Membership

idOrg.description: The ID or name of the organization (workspace). Can be a 24-character hex ID like '6155b3f4a3a384789a7f1492' or the organization's short name like 'myteam'.
idOrg.title: Id Org

member.description: Determines whether to include the member object in the response. Valid values are 'true' or 'false'.
member.title: Member

member_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields for the member object. Valid values: 'all', 'avatarHash', 'bio', 'bioData', 'confirmed', 'fullName', 'idPremOrgsAdmin', 'initials', 'memberType', 'products', 'status', 'url', 'username'.
member_fields.title: Member Fields

inputSchema.title: GetOrgMembershipRequest

name: get_org_membership

GetOrgMembershipResponse.description: Response schema containing the detailed information for the requested organization membership.

idMember.description: The ID of the member associated with this membership
idMember.title: Id Member

member.description: Nested member object (included when member=true query parameter is used)
member.title: Member

unconfirmed.description: Whether the membership is unconfirmed (pending confirmation)
unconfirmed.title: Unconfirmed

GetOrgMembershipResponse.title: GetOrgMembershipResponse

Member.description: Member object containing detailed information about the member.

avatarHash.description: Hash of the member's avatar image
avatarHash.title: Avatar Hash

avatarUrl.description: URL of the member's avatar image
avatarUrl.title: Avatar Url

bioData.description: Structured biography data of the member
bioData.title: Bio Data

confirmed.description: Whether the member account is confirmed
confirmed.title: Confirmed

fullName.description: Full name of the member (returns username if privacy setting is not public)
fullName.title: Full Name

idPremOrgsAdmin.description: Array of IDs for premium organizations this member administers
idPremOrgsAdmin.title: Id Prem Orgs Admin

products.description: Array of Trello products the member has access to
products.title: Products

url.description: URL to the member's Trello profile
url.title: Url

Member.title: Member
